			if = {

					has_owner = yes

						is_rebel_country = no

		location:palembang = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_owner = yes
					owner = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						NOT = { this = root }
						NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
						NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
					}
				}
				owner = { add_to_list = source }
			}
		}
		every_neighbor_country = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
				NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
				has_ports = yes
				any_owned_location = {
					region = region:indonesia_region
				}
			}
			add_to_list = source
		}
	}
	score = {
		add = 26
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target = {
					OR = {
						owns = location:malacca
						owns = location:temasek

					}
				}
			}
			add = 16
		}
	}
	sort_value = {
		add = 85
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target = {
					any_owned_location = { region = region:indonesia_region }
				}
			}
			add = 25
		}
	}
}

				any_owned_location = {
					OR = {
						region = region:great_britain_region

							current_year >= 1600

								region = region:bengal_region
